```{r}
# Initialize filenames
swl_qced_phenotypes_filename <- "swl_qced_phenotypes.csv"
raine_qced_phenotypes_filename <- "raine_qced_phenotypes.csv"

swl_demographics_filename <- "swl_demographics.csv"
raine_demographics_filename <- "raine_demographics.csv"

# Create output directories if they don't exist
invisible(lapply(c(
  here("output", "prepared", "tables"),
  here("output", "prepared", "figures")
), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))
```

# Load and prep data

```{r}
# Load phenotype data
dat_swl_qced <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", swl_qced_phenotypes_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_raine_qced <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", raine_qced_phenotypes_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Load demographics data
swl_demographics <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", swl_demographics_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
  )

raine_demographics <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", raine_demographics_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Prep demographics data
swl_demographics <- swl_demographics %>%
  select(pid, age, sex, bmi)

raine_demographics <- raine_demographics %>%
  select(pid, age, sex, bmi)

# Merge accelerometer data with demographics
dat_swl_qced <- merge(dat_swl_qced,
                      swl_demographics,
                      by = "pid",
                      all = FALSE)

dat_raine_qced <- merge(dat_raine_qced,
                        raine_demographics,
                        by = "pid",
                        all = FALSE)

# Prep age and BMI subgroups
dat_swl_qced <- dat_swl_qced %>%
  mutate(age_2gp = factor(ifelse(age < 40, "Younger", "Older"), 
                          levels = c("Younger", "Older")),
         bmi_2gp = factor(ifelse(bmi < 25, "<25", "25+"), 
                          levels = c("<25", "25+")))

dat_raine_qced <- dat_raine_qced %>%
  mutate(age_2gp = factor(ifelse(age < 60, "Younger", "Older"), 
                          levels = c("Younger", "Older")),
         bmi_2gp = factor(ifelse(bmi < 25, "<25", "25+"), 
                          levels = c("<25", "25+")))

# Convert MVPA from hours to mins
dat_swl_qced <- dat_swl_qced %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("mvpa"), ~ .x * 60))

dat_raine_qced <- dat_raine_qced %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("mvpa"), ~ .x * 60))

# Remove dataframes to save space
rm(swl_demographics, raine_demographics)
```

# Stratified agreement

## Prepare results DataFrame

```{r}
phenotypes <- c("overall_activity_mean", 
                "steps_mean", 
                "cadence_peak1_mean", 
                "mvpa_mean", 
                "lipa_mean", 
                "sedentary_mean")
subgroups  <- c("age_2gp", "sex", "bmi_2gp")

# Loop over subgroups and phenotypes and calculate stratified correlations and SMA regression equations
stratified_results <- list()
for (subg in subgroups) {
  for (pheno in phenotypes) {
    skewed_phenotype <- startsWith(pheno, "mvpa")
    
    # SWL
    res_swl <- stratified_correlation(dat_swl_qced, 
                                      pheno, 
                                      subg, 
                                      skewed_phenotype) %>%
      mutate(study = "swl",
             phenotype = pheno,
             analysis = subg,
             subgroup = as.character(subgroup))

    # Raine
    res_raine <- stratified_correlation(dat_raine_qced, 
                                        pheno, 
                                        subg, 
                                        skewed_phenotype) %>%
      mutate(study = "raine",
             phenotype = pheno,
             analysis = subg,
             subgroup = as.character(subgroup))

    # Add both to the growing list
    stratified_results[[length(stratified_results) + 1]] <- res_swl
    stratified_results[[length(stratified_results) + 1]] <- res_raine
  }
}

stratified_results <- bind_rows(stratified_results) %>%
  relocate(study, phenotype, analysis)
```

## Prepare results for plotting

```{r}
row_labels <- data.frame(phenotype = c("overall_activity_mean",
                                       "steps_mean",
                                       "cadence_peak1_mean",
                                       "mvpa_mean",
                                       "lipa_mean",
                                       "sedentary_mean"),
                         label = c("Overall activity (mg/day)",
                                   "Step count (steps/day)",
                                   "Peak 1-min cadence (steps/min)",
                                   "MVPA (minutes/day)*",
                                   "Light physical activity (hours/day)",
                                   "Sedentary behaviour (hours/day)"))

# Prep age, sex and BMI results dataframes
stratified_results_age <- stratified_results %>%
  filter(analysis == "age_2gp") %>%
  mutate(mycolour = if_else(subgroup == "Younger", "black", "white"),
         subgroup_numbered = if_else(subgroup == "Younger", "gp1", "gp2"))

stratified_results_sex <- stratified_results %>%
  filter(analysis == "sex") %>%
  mutate(mycolour = if_else(subgroup == "Male", "black", "white"),
         subgroup_numbered = if_else(subgroup == "Male", "gp1", "gp2"))

stratified_results_bmi <- stratified_results %>%
  filter(analysis == "bmi_2gp") %>%
  mutate(mycolour = if_else(subgroup == "<25", "black", "white"),
         subgroup_numbered = if_else(subgroup == "<25", "gp1", "gp2"))
```

# Table S2: Regression equations by subgroups of age, sex, BMI for SWL and Raine Study Gen1

```{r}
# Initialise subgroup columns
subgroup_cols <- c("Younger", "Older", "Male", "Female", "<25", "25+")

# Prepare table for each study
swl_equations_table   <- make_equations_table(stratified_results, 
                                              study_str = "swl",
                                              phenotypes = phenotypes,
                                              subgroup_cols = subgroup_cols)
raine_equations_table <- make_equations_table(stratified_results, 
                                              study_str = "raine",
                                              phenotypes = phenotypes,
                                              subgroup_cols = subgroup_cols)

# Save output to .docx
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(
    "SMART Work & Life (Wrist vs. thigh)", prop = fp_text(bold = TRUE)
  ))) %>%
  body_add_table(value = swl_equations_table) %>%
  body_add_par("") %>%
  body_add_fpar(fpar(ftext(
    "Raine Study Gen1 (Wrist vs. hip)", prop = fp_text(bold = TRUE)
  ))) %>%
  body_add_table(value = raine_equations_table)

print(doc, target = here("output", "prepared", "tables", "Table_S2.docx"))
```

# Figure S7: Age forest plot

```{r}
# Pull counts from the results table
n_counts <- stratified_results_age %>%
  distinct(study, subgroup, n) %>%
  tidyr::unite(key, study, subgroup) %>%
  tibble::deframe()

n_swl_g1   <- n_counts["swl_Younger"]
n_swl_g2   <- n_counts["swl_Older"]
n_raine_g1 <- n_counts["raine_Younger"]
n_raine_g2 <- n_counts["raine_Older"]

# Prepare figure labels
label_swl <- glue::glue(
  "SMART Work & Life (wrist vs. thigh) \n Young (n={n_swl_g1}) vs Middle-aged adults (n={n_swl_g2})"
)
label_raine <- glue::glue(
  "Raine Study Gen1 (wrist vs. hip) \n Middle-aged (n={n_raine_g1}) vs Older adults (n={n_raine_g2})"
)

# Create forest plot
figure <- forest_plot(
  setNames(list(stratified_results_age %>% filter(study == "swl"),
                stratified_results_age %>% filter(study == "raine")),
           c(as.character(label_swl), as.character(label_raine))),
  col.key = "phenotype",
  col.estimate = "corr_est",
  col.lci = "corr_lci",
  col.uci = "corr_uci",
  row.labels = row_labels,
  xlab = "r (95% CI)",
  xlim = c(0.2, 1.0),
  exponentiate = FALSE,
  col.keep = "subgroup_numbered",
  fill = "mycolour",
  shape = "square filled",
  data.function = "move_rows",
  ciunder = TRUE,
  ci.delim = ", ",
  stroke = 0.5,
  row.labels.heading = "Phenotype",
  plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 2, 8, "mm"),
  mid.space = unit(15, "mm")
)

ggsave(filename = here("output", "prepared", "figures", "Figure_S7.png"),
       plot = figure$plot,
       width = 21,
       height = 11,
       units = "cm",
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
```
